competitor.name: Hub International
competitor.description: Leading full-service global insurance broker and financial services firm providing risk management, employee benefits, and personal lines.

items.title: Hub International Acquires Western Transportation Risk Specialist
items.summary: Hub expanded its national Transportation Practice with the acquisition of MilePost Fleet Insurance, serving 1,100 long-haul and regional trucking fleets.

items.title: Hub Launches Proprietary VIU Digital Personal Lines Platform Expansion
items.summary: Expanded VIU by HUB omni-channel personal lines brokerage into commercial small-business auto and BOP insurance.

items.title: Hub International Appoints Chief Technology Officer to Lead AI Automation
items.summary: Named Elena Rostova as Executive VP and Chief Information Officer to accelerate quote automation and broker workflow digitization.

items.title: Hub Commercial Rate Monitor Reports Continued Commercial Auto Escalation
items.summary: Hub's risk research division tracked 12.4% rate increases on heavy vehicle fleet policies due to social inflation and litigation costs.

items.title: Hub Closes Strategic Acquisition of Hospitality Risk Specialists
items.summary: Completed acquisition of InnKeepers Risk Services, deepening hotel, restaurant, and venue property and liquor liability expertise.

battlecard_template.headline: PE-Backed Mid-Market Aggregator Scaling Specialized Industry Verticals
battlecard_template.subtext: Hub combines private equity capital backing with deep vertical specialization in hospitality, transportation, and construction middle-market accounts.

wins.title: Long-Term Strategic Partner vs. Private Equity Flipping
wins.text: Highlight our stable, long-term independent ownership against Hub's multi-sponsor private equity refinancing cycles.

wins.title: Transparent Client-First Fee Advisory
wins.text: Position our unbundled fee transparency against Hub's proprietary product placement incentives and carrier overriding commissions.

wins.title: Bespoke Middle-Market Risk Engineering
wins.text: Provide tailored risk mitigation engineering instead of Hub's standardized, off-the-shelf automated risk checklists.

moves.summary: Acquired MilePost Fleet Insurance to strengthen national commercial transportation practice.
Expanded VIU by HUB digital platform into small-business commercial auto and BOP coverage.
Appointed Elena Rostova as CIO to drive automated digital workflow across broker branches.
